data.title: Subtraction with Borrowing
data.description: Learn how to borrow from the tens place when the ones digit is too small to subtract.

challenges.hint: You cannot take 7 ones from 2 ones! Borrow 1 ten and turn it into 10 ones.
challenges.narration: Let's subtract 17 from 52. Uh oh, 2 is smaller than 7 in the ones place! We need to borrow!

challenges.hint: Look at the ones place: 3 is smaller than 8. Trade a ten rod for 10 ones cubes.
challenges.narration: Time for the next problem. Can you take 8 from 3 without borrowing? Not quite!

challenges.hint: 1 one is less than 5 ones. Borrow from the tens column to get started.
challenges.narration: Here is our final subtraction challenge. Watch those ones places closely!

regroupingSteps.narration: We take 1 ten from the tens place, leaving 4 tens, and add 10 ones to the 2 ones to make 12 ones.

wordProblemContext.imagePrompt: A classroom with base-ten blocks on a table, showing tens rods and ones cubes.
wordProblemContext.story: You have a collection of base-ten blocks. When you need to take away some objects and don't have enough ones, you borrow a ten!
